Riya (SE): kicking off POC with EdgeRetail. They need streaming SDK that supports function/tool calls + incremental structured JSON frames. Also EU residency, SOC2, will proxy through partner gateway. Any flags?
Tom (AE): Customer wants cost ballpark for 500 qps baseline, burst to 2k, plus reserved capacity options. Also asks about SSO and KMS.
Marcus (Platform Eng): We support SSE and websockets. Main risk is long-lived proxies dropping streaming connections; keepalive and chunking settings matter. Ephemeral creds behind proxy usually work if token rotation is handled server-side.
Riya (SE): SDK question — best pattern to parse streaming tool calls when the model emits partial JSON? Need to avoid double-parse errors.
Marcus (Platform Eng): Use the SDK's stream parser helper. Pattern:
```js
const stream = client.streamGeneration(opts);
stream.on('chunk', c => {
  if(c.event === 'tool_call') handleToolChunk(c.payload);
  if(c.event === 'delta') bufferDelta(c.text);
});
```
Buffer until 'tool_call' close event before JSON.parse. Also support `content-type: application/llm-events+json` for explicit framing.
Leah (Security): For EU on Dedicated/Private we require SSO + customer KMS. For POC you can provision short-lived API keys, but don't promise production compliance. I'll circulate the security checklist.
Riya (SE): How do we handle webhook callbacks from customer tools? They plan to host tool endpoints behind a private gateway.
Marcus (Platform Eng): Two options: 1) Customer exposes endpoint reachable from our runtime (ip allowlist + TLS). 2) Use our relay/connector pattern where the runtime polls or tunnels. If using relays, expect ~100ms extra latency and extra egress controls.
Tom (AE): Latency SLO question — they want 200-300ms P50 for 512 tokens when invoking a tool. Feasible?
Marcus (Platform Eng): With Dedicated GPUs and no batch queuing, sub-300ms p50 for a 1-2 token function-call handshake is plausible for optimized weights. However tool execution time and network RTT to webhook dominate. Recommend canary and measure.
Riya (SE): Pricing needed before next customer call. Actionable numbers please.
Marcus (Platform Eng): I'll run the cost simulator if you share tokens/session and avg response length.
Leah (Security): I'll send the security questionnaire and minimum network diagram template.

Riya (SE): Agreed. Scheduling follow-up call Tue 10:00 CET. :thumbsup:
Marcus (Platform Eng): noted.
Leah (Security): noted.
Tom (AE): thanks everyone.
